content: Need: Evaluation Suite Health now governs whether a suite is trustworthy, but repeated runs can still vary and infrastructure noise can make small score differences look exact. Intent: add schema-backed trial variance and infrastructure uncertainty inputs, confidence ranges, and deterministic CRD-UNCERTAINTY readiness logic for v0.6.29. Context: remain domain-general; do not treat trial count, narrow intervals, or low variance as quality itself; keep framework learning as the following independent slice.
